utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ve got the supplies list here—what’s still missing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Looks like we still need a few more tools and maybe some extra hands, but I’ll spread the word right away. Thanks, Bo—your list will help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks, Quinn—I'll keep the list handy. Let me know if anything else comes up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I think I might’ve missed the latest details again; what do I need to know?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard that it’s small fixes on Saturday, and Gus can lend a drill if needed. I’m still waiting on the exact time and meeting spot.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, got it — Saturday, small fixes, and Gus has a drill if we need one. Just send me the time and meeting spot when you hear them, and I’ll try to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m here now—what still needs doing for the repair drive, and do you need me to bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Dane. Let’s make the list first, then pick a meeting time and split up the errands—if you can bring any donated tools, that would help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll bring any donated tools I can and help with the list. Just tell me the meeting time once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the repair drive plan to the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate you helping spread the word. Just so everyone’s on the same page, the repair drive is Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll let everyone nearby know the repair drive is Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll ask around and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it. Just let me know when you hear the time and where folks should meet.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll ask around and let you know the time and meeting spot as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great — I can work around school pickup. Please send the repair drive time and meeting spot, and I’ll plan from there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m pretty sure I promised a few supplies, though I may need to check my note and make sure I bring the right ones.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks — just send me the repair drive time and meeting spot when you confirm, and I’ll work around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’d start with Rey and the folks who asked about repairs first, then share the Saturday details as soon as we have the time and meeting spot.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—I’ll confirm Rey and the others first, then share the Saturday time and meeting spot as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — thanks, Hana. I’ll keep an eye out and help spread the Saturday details once you have them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m still on the lookout for hand tools and spare parts. If you have the repair drive time or meeting spot, send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still waiting on the repair drive time and meeting spot, but I’ll keep the notes updated. Send me the details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll send them over as soon as I get them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s still on for this weekend, right? I just want to make sure I’ve got that straight.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, it’s still on this weekend. What time should I bring the tools?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — thanks for confirming. So we’re still on for this weekend, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Late afternoon still seems best to me—around 4:30, if that works. I just need the exact meet-up spot and what tools to bring so I can plan properly.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh yes — I’ll check the exact meet-up spot and the tool list, then I’ll pass it right along to you.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess — once you have that, I can plan around it. Just let me know the spot and tools when you know them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It’s this Saturday by the community hall, and we’re collecting tools, spare parts, and donations. If you can swing by, even for a little while, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll be there Saturday at 10 to help with the tools and repair lists. If you need anything sorted before then, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’s great, Mara — 10 works perfectly. I’ll let you know if anything needs sorting before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, thanks — I’ll look out for them and keep it low-key.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Uli — I’ll send over the missing supplies list so Opal can add it to the repair drive notes.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Got it, thanks, Cleo. I’ll keep an eye out for the list.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Kira — I’ll send you the repair drive details and the Saturday info by the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just making sure — the repair drive is still on for Saturday, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, it’s still on for this Saturday by the community hall. I’ll send the details over right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes—please do spread the word: it’s now Sunday at the community center, and I’ll be there to help keep everything running smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely, I’ll spread the word about Sunday at the community center and let folks know you’ll be there. I’ll ask around while I’m out and report back if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate it. Let me know if you hear of anyone who needs help, and I’ll keep everything ready for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks — if you send me the exact repair drive time and meeting spot, I can work around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll confirm the exact time and meeting spot, then send it over as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks — once you confirm it, I can plan around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the supplies list here, Pia — what’s still missing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think we’re set on the tools, but I’m still worried about the exact drop-off and who’s handling the pickup. If you know the timing, I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still waiting on the pickup details, but let’s plan for a 4:30 meet-up near the community hall. I’ll confirm the exact drop-off as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what part of the repair drive needs me most?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m pretty sure I promised a few supplies, though I may need to check my note and make sure I bring the right ones.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No worries — just check your note and bring whatever’s listed. If you want, I can help fill in anything missing once you’ve looked.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Vik — I’m still waiting on any updates about the repair drive. If you hear anything, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll pass along any repair drive updates to everyone nearby.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Vik — appreciate it. Just let me know if anything comes up about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep — it’s on Sunday at the community center, and I can bring my drill and toolkit. Folks can also bring any small parts they already have.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll note Sunday at the community center, plus the drill, toolkit, and any small parts people have. I’ll still double-check the drop-off location and repair hours before I pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Hana — thanks for double-checking the drop-off location and repair hours. I’ll bring the drill and toolkit Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m not sure yet, but I’m glad people are helping out. If you can, stop by Saturday at the community hall — we could still use tools, spare parts, and donations.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday at the community hall works for me. If you can send the list of needed tools and parts, I’ll plan my stop and bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Eli — that really helps. I’ll send over the list as soon as I get the latest, and even a short stop would be appreciated.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I must’ve missed the details; what do I need to know?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it’s shaping up nicely — people are bringing tools, supplies, and plenty of goodwill. If you want, I can fill you in on what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, please — I’d appreciate the quick rundown on what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Uli — I’ll keep the repair drive notes updated and wait for the location details.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Of course — I’ll send the location details as soon as I can. Thanks for keeping the notes updated.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Uli — I’ll be ready to update the repair drive notes as soon as the location details come in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Leo. The main gap is still common hand tools and a few likely-fit spare parts—if you spot anything specific that’s missing, send me the list and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll check the tools and spares and send you a short missing-items list.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Perfect, thanks Leo — send the list when you have it, and I’ll share it with Rosa for the flyer.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes — definitely still on for 10. I’ll be there to help point you to the tools and repair lists.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, 10 works for me — thanks. I’ll keep an eye out for the meeting spot and tool list.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — I’ll meet you there at 10 and help get you oriented. If you arrive first, just look for me by the tool table.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
